final_message:
Configured the requested IPv4 names and MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu`. All 40 PCs use the resolver on pc34 (10.15.9.12); existing addresses and routes remain unchanged.

The internal DNS hierarchy uses pc1 as root; pc2–pc5 for the four TLDs; and pc6, pc8–pc10, pc12–pc15, pc21, pc32 and pc33 for the delegated zones. Their images and pc34’s were changed to `kathara/bind`; DNS files and startup commands were added.

Static checks passed for the zone delegations, glue, MX records and client configurations. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and the lab was not started, so live resolution remains to be verified. The MX records identify the mail hosts; they do not configure mail services.
